// One item, one page; no persistent variables or game-state writes.
// ITEMINFO_ALIASNAME is the item-ID override, not ITEMINFO_VIEW (appearance).
prt_in,170,130,0	script	Item Guide#knife1201	105,{
	mes "[Item Guide]";
	if (getiteminfo(1201, ITEMINFO_ID) != 1201) {
		mes "Item 1201 is unavailable. No item facts are qualified.";
		close;
	}
	mes "Item facts from this server's loaded item database.";
	mes "Canonical item ID: " + getiteminfo(1201, ITEMINFO_ID);
	mes "Item type code: " + getiteminfo(1201, ITEMINFO_TYPE);
	mes "Weight (raw engine units): " + getiteminfo(1201, ITEMINFO_WEIGHT);
	mes "View item ID override (0 means canonical): " + getiteminfo(1201, ITEMINFO_ALIASNAME);
	mes "Database buy price (Zeny): " + getiteminfo(1201, ITEMINFO_BUY);
	mes "These are item facts, not a shop quote or permission to buy.";
	close;
}
